entities.summary: Dominic Angelo Breazeale is an American former professional boxer who competed from 2012 to 2021. He challenged for the world heavyweight championship twice; for the IBF title in 2016 and WBC title in 2019. As an amateur, he represented the United States at the 2012 London Olympics.
